published_prior_art.cite: SongEtAl2026CategoricalIV gives the sharp categorical-IV compatible joint counterfactual set; MastinJailletChin2014RandomizedRegret gives the finite-scenario randomized minimax-regret LP.
MastinJailletChin2014RandomizedRegret supplies the relevant finite-game primal-dual machinery; the proposed pure-rule certificate is its application to the IV state polytope.
HruzaEtAl2026CategoricalPIL supplies the interval-rule comparator; the stated frontier is a useful but largely definition-driven comparison.
Stoye2007ManyTreatments Proposition 1 is the stated spike-state allocation result; the categorical-IV implication is a sanity specialization.
HruzaEtAl2026CategoricalPIL uses deterministic coordinatewise-bound rules and does not provide this categorical-IV joint-polytope witness.
SongEtAl2026CategoricalIV gives finite-sample confidence procedures for counterfactual functionals; ChernozhukovHongTamer2007Sets gives minimizer-set inference.
ClopperPearson1934Binomial supplies the simultaneous cellwise event; the displayed deployed-regret inequality is a direct robust-supremum consequence.
KlattMunkZemel2022RandomLP and LiuBuneaNilesWeed2023LPConfidence cover random-right-hand-side LP optimizer asymptotics, but not yet this stated moving-coefficient categorical-IV formulation.
FangSantos2019DirectionalInference and LiuBuneaNilesWeed2023LPConfidence are adjacent, but neither states uniform contraction for this optimizer-correspondence graph.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1
novelty_flags.one_line: The sharp categorical-IV set plus the randomized finite-scenario minimax LP is an immediate composition of SongEtAl2026CategoricalIV and MastinJailletChin2014RandomizedRegret, so it cannot carry the paper as a new theorem-level kernel.

novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 / project literature map
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey omits close treatment-choice work, notably Masten (2023) on many-treatment minimax regret and Cui (2021) on randomized minimax decisions under partial identification.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 5
soundness_flags.one_line: One law on which the rectangle optimizer differs does not prove that no rule using only marginal intervals can return the joint optimum at that law; either state only failure of the rectangle oracle or exhibit two laws with identical intervals and incompatible joint optima.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper gives a sharp characterization of compatible joint potential-outcome distributions for categorical IV models and computes sharp linear-functional bounds by linear programming.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3, equations (28)-(30) and Theorem 1; Section 4, equations (62)-(65) and Theorem 4
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: For finite discrete or interval uncertainty, randomized minimax regret is represented by a linear program over mixed actions and has value no greater than deterministic minimax regret.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 3.1, equations (8)-(9) and Proposition 3.1; Section 7, paragraphs 433-434
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper chooses a deterministic action minimizing an interval-based worst-case loss and says randomized-decision extensions require additional methodological development.

source_verification_receipts.version: arXiv:2007.13473 preprint corresponding to the 2022 Annals of Operations Research article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The analyzed LP has a randomly perturbed right-hand side and develops optimizer/value limit laws and Hausdorff optimal-set rates under degeneracy-sensitive geometry.
The paper derives limits and asymptotically valid confidence sets for solutions and full optimal-solution sets of random-constraint LPs using auxiliary LPs.

source_verification_receipts.version: Econometric Theory 23(1), 190-199, 2007; theorem text not publicly accessible through the inspected primary landing page
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The source confirms the paper and its many-treatment minimax-regret scope, but the Proposition 1 formula should be checked in the journal PDF before relying on an equation-level comparison.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace Theorem 5's overbroad intervals-only conclusion with the exact rectangle-oracle separation, or construct a paired same-marginal-interval categorical-IV law whose joint optimizer differs.

Add Masten (2023) and Cui (2021), then distinguish population mixed-action minimax regret from their statistical-rule randomization and identify the exact feature of the categorical-IV fiber that their results do not cover.

Re-center the field contribution on a proved moving-coefficient active-system theorem: give one canonical LP/KKT formulation, show why no fixed-matrix right-hand-side reparameterization applies, and derive a genuinely new uniform limit or face-intersection result.

recommended_next_step: Revise by demoting the generic sharp-set-plus-saddle composition to background, repairing the witness quantifier, and making the moving-coefficient inference or a nontrivial categorical-IV separation theorem the field-level kernel.
